sample: 16 fixed files out of 192 per UTC day: 00,03,06,09,12,15,18,21; English and translated streams
grouping: Exact normalized title + language + UTC observation day; short titles use URL. One median document tone per group.
limitations: Exploratory document tone, not a validated reputation index or country-targeted sentiment.
Fixed systematic time sample; unsampled files and rejected rows are not zero articles.
Title relevance and publisher geography are only partly verified; unknown publishers retained and counted.
Known domestic publishers excluded. No weighting by audience, language or publisher type.
No validated bridge to historical DOC or the October 7–12 pilot. Series remain separate.
Source-composition control and independent relevance validation remain pending.
